item: No operator price exists in this namespace
description: All 39 originated markets have blank market, residual and CLV columns.
why_unverified: No licensed odds feed; operator terms not reviewed.
disposition: Blank + flagged; gate G4 fails; no staking claim is made anywhere.

item: No prop or SGP market source
description: Same-game and prop combos cannot be priced or validated.
why_unverified: No official prop feed exists.
disposition: S5 and S6 remain blocked; no marginal multiplication is performed.

item: Venue disagreement between two official pages
description: Schedule page ticket link says FedEx Field; the game centre Game Info block says NORTHWEST STADIUM, Landover MD.
why_unverified: Two official pages, one name each.
disposition: Game centre preferred; both quoted; flagged for review.

item: Standings extract is partial by design
description: Only W-L-T-PCT-PF-PA were captured; home/road/division/conference columns were not.
why_unverified: Extract scope.
disposition: Those columns are left out of every table rather than guessed.

item: Corpus club codes differ from league abbreviations
description: The carried 136-game file uses LAR/ARI/WSH; the league table uses LA/AZ/WAS.
why_unverified: Source convention.
disposition: Mapped explicitly in pipeline.py (CLUB_ALIASES), never silently.

item: Home-field term is negative this season
description: Mean home margin, weeks 1-9 2026 = -0.50 points (n=136); the frozen model therefore carries a negative HFA.
why_unverified: This is what the official finals say; it has not been compared with prior seasons.
disposition: Published as-is and raised as question Q04; not smoothed to a textbook value.

item: No depth chart captured at all
description: Starter status, depth rank, replacement identity and 1st-4th string columns are blank for all 253 rows.
why_unverified: No club depth page and no snap counts captured.
disposition: Blank + flagged; the deficiency matrix is not published because it would fabricate starters.

item: No inactive list or game book captured
description: Whether a listed player actually sat is unknown.
why_unverified: Week 11 games had not been played at capture; no game books read.
disposition: Blank + flagged; G5 cannot pass.

item: No snap counts captured
description: The playing-time route to depth (the preferred route) is unverified.
why_unverified: No official snap-count page captured.
disposition: Route (b) unverified; recorded as the top data request.

item: Questionable cannot be calibrated yet
description: No archived designations-to-inactives join exists, so no play-rate estimate is possible.
why_unverified: n=0 seasons archived in this namespace.
disposition: No percentage is published anywhere; old-vintage figures are refused.

item: The injury report has no publication timestamp
description: Only our read clock exists, so a true delta between captures cannot be labelled with the publisher's time.
why_unverified: The page prints no timestamp.
disposition: Read clock published; deltas deferred until >= 2 hashed captures exist.

item: Lions designations do not match the brief
description: At the Week 11 read, Kerby Joseph and D.J. Reed carry practice status with a blank game status, and Cade Mays is DNP with a blank status. The brief states all three are Out.
why_unverified: The page read here does not print Out for them; the brief cites a different article.
disposition: Neither value is asserted; the row is flagged for review with both claims quoted.

item: 'Not listed' does not mean available
description: Lamar Jackson does not appear on the Week 11 injury report because he is on injured reserve (2026-11-13 article), not because he is healthy. No reserve list is captured.
why_unverified: The report lists only active-roster players.
disposition: Flagged; a reserve/IR capture is the top availability request.

item: Some announced-starter claims are headline-only
description: The Watson and Beck starter announcements come from a roundup headline; the body text was not read in full.
why_unverified: Only headline text was captured for that row.
disposition: Recorded as headline-level evidence, not body-level.

item: No weather, roof or surface data
description: The totals model has no environment input.
why_unverified: No roof designation or NWS forecast captured.
disposition: Totals are published with that limitation stated.

item: Market residuals blank for all 39 markets
description: The residual columns exist but hold no value.
why_unverified: Same cause as F-01.
disposition: Blank + flagged.

item: The 136-game corpus is carried, not re-scraped
description: It was reconciled against official standings (32/32 MATCH) but not re-read page by page in this session.
why_unverified: Re-reading 136 game pages was out of scope for this session.
disposition: Reconciliation is the evidence; the residual risk is a transcription error that cancels out.

item: No operator terms were reviewed
description: Scraping operator odds may breach their terms.
why_unverified: No operator terms read.
disposition: No operator page was fetched; policy P-01 forbids it until terms are read.

item: Reward amounts are blank
description: The competition has tiers but no pool.
why_unverified: No funding decision exists.
disposition: Blank + flagged; no payout is promised.

item: No 2026 rule-book text read
description: Kickoff/onside priors are not applied.
why_unverified: Rule book not read in this session.
disposition: No prior is applied rather than applying an unsourced one.

item: Both totals estimators lose to a constant mean
description: On the Week 10 holdout, estimator A has skill -0.121 and B -0.084 against a constant league-mean total.
why_unverified: n=14; the sample is small, but the sign is not in our favour.
disposition: Published on the landing page rather than hidden; raised as Q14.

item: Scheduled byte-level capture cannot run from this environment
description: snapshot_fetch.py was written and executed; all five official URLs failed TLS negotiation from the build sandbox (0 of 5 captured).
why_unverified: The build environment has egress only to a small allowlist; nfl.com is reachable only through the page-read tool.
disposition: Captures in this session are processed-text extracts with hashes, not server bytes (see raw/README.txt); the scheduled job must run outside this sandbox, and the failure is left in data/capture_store/index.csv as evidence.

item: Game designations cover only 2 of 13 fixtures
description: 16 of 253 report rows carry a game designation; the other 11 fixtures show practice status only.
why_unverified: Designations are typically published later in the week.
disposition: Count published; no designation is inferred from practice status.
